spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact proposed window.setResizable(bool) surface, observes both (resizable: true) and (resizable: false) exhaustively, and demonstrates the spec's distinction that only user resizing is blocked while window.resizeTo() stays API-allowed.

interactive.rationale: Lock/unlock buttons invoke the real method with a resolve/reject log, a live pill readout tracks method presence and media matches with change listeners, and a resizeTo() probe reports before/after outer dimensions.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises setResizable(false) plus observation of the resizable media values and the user-resize vs Web-API distinction; the page delivers all three.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles method-absent honestly, distinguishes both-values-match (inconsistent) and neither-matches (support not established), and the resizeTo branch explicitly refuses to claim proof when no locked state was established.

references.rationale: See-also cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5201832664629248 and all three sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: window-setresizable-exposed and resizable-reports-an-active-value in the feature suite mirror this page's contract, with the setresizable-flips-resizable-state manual assertion honestly blocked; current fails are the expected absent surface in Chromium 141, not demo bugs.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this session): desktop screenshot shows the honest undefined/false pills and non-established effective state, zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; lock/unlock/resizeTo clicks could not be driven in the non-interactive harness.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the observed method/media state and resolved/rejected/unavailable outcomes for each call.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; pill-off pairs --accent-rose with --bg-ivory text and secondary buttons override background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with focus-visible outlines, a role=log aria-live results region, and pill states duplicated as text (function/undefined, true/false) rather than colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated mobile 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow with the button row wrapping cleanly; desktop 1280×800 clean; only the environmental fonts.googleapis.com request fails.

openQuestions.title: Verify the lock actually flips (resizable: false) in a flagged installed window
openQuestions.detail: The full contract — setResizable(false) resolving, (resizable: false) starting to match, user drag-resize blocked while resizeTo() still applies — requires an installed desktop PWA with the AWC flag and window-management permission, which neither this headless session nor a plain tab can supply. When such an environment is available, run the lock/unlock cycle, capture the pill transitions and the resizeTo-while-locked log line, and attach the evidence to the blocked setresizable-flips-resizable-state manual conformance assertion.

summary: Spec-faithful probe of the proposed setResizable() surface with an exhaustive two-value resizable media readout, honest inconsistent/unsupported states, and a resizeTo() comparison that never overclaims. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this cloud session): honest fallback rendering, zero console errors, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on mobile 360×740 or desktop 1280×800. Success-path evidence awaits an implementing installed-app window.
